summary: The three-large-eigenvalue condition does not force one physical triple whose entire rank-two cross bank has uniformly bounded reciprocal aggregate determinant cost. For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), whose nonzero spectrum is {1,1,-1}, taking the singleton plus one coordinate from each bank gives transverse curvature a=1 but Delta_2=sqrt(pdet(MM^T))=(m-1)/m^2, so the aggregate gate cost Delta_2^(-1/2)=m/sqrt(m-1) diverges like sqrt(m). This is not a counterexample to QFORM: the completed account03/B01 diffuse-rank-two plus dependence-safe-square theorem controls the same family uniformly by <7.692.
scope_note: Refutes only a one-triple aggregate rank-two structural closure. It does not refute the new rank-two crossbank theorem at its stated quantitative scope and does not refute the full target.
